scope: ARWP Image Discovery IDL-01 through IDL-08 applied to the reviewed CBT Cards editorial visual cohort defined by scripts/apply_editorial_visuals.py.

findings.evidence: Each reviewed editorial page keeps responsive WebP sources and uses the 1536x1024 PNG as the ordinary img fallback and preferred image; bounded live verification fetches the deployed pages and image bytes.
The finalizer aligns og:image, twitter:image, WebPage.primaryImageOfPage and Article.image to the same high-resolution PNG artwork.
Only the reviewed editorial visual cohort receives image:image/image:loc entries; deprecated image sitemap fields are rejected.

The rollout reuses the explicitly authored visual descriptions from the VISUALS registry and carries them to visible alt, og:image:alt and twitter:image:alt without generating new clinical or visual claims.
max-image-preview:large is required for the cohort and noimageindex is treated as a conflict with the intended image-discovery surface.

Preferred PNG assets are read from their actual file headers; the gate reports the subset meeting the Discover-oriented >=1200px and >=300000-pixel guidance without relabelling it as a universal indexing requirement.
Existing 560w/1024w WebP picture sources remain intact while the high-resolution PNG becomes the normal img src fallback, preserving a straightforward crawlable image URL.
The rollout does not invent per-image ownership or clinical provenance. Existing CBT Cards license checks remain authoritative and deprecated image-sitemap licensing fields are not introduced.
